summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Large-Cap 2x Daily ETF (USLX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund uses swap agreements and other financial instruments to pursue 2x leveraged exposure to the daily performance of the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO), before fees and expenses. The fund does not aim to achieve 2x of the underlying ETF for any period other than a single day. USLX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
